issues.source_quote: Что ты Геша... спасибо.
issues.translation_quote: Come on, Gesha... thank you.
issues.justification: Minor mismatch but the larger issue is elsewhere; kept for context.

issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш любимый шеф, если человек идиот - то это надолго.
issues.translation_quote: As our beloved boss says: 'If a man is an idiot, it's for a long time!'
issues.justification: The punchy aphorism is rendered clumsily and literally; a natural English form ('Once an idiot, always an idiot' / 'Stupidity is forever') is needed for the joke to land.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a whole ticket pack, win... a tractor rack!
issues.justification: The rhyming lottery jingle's absurd prize (водокачка, water pump tower) is changed to 'tractor rack', which is meaningless; the humor of the nonsense prize is lost.

issues.source_quote: за чужой счёт пьют даже трезвенники и язвенники
issues.translation_quote: even teetotalers and convalescers drink
issues.justification: 'Язвенники' means people with ulcers, not 'convalescers'; the joke (even those who can't drink do so for free) is distorted.

issues.source_quote: Я думаю, Семён Семёныч, каждый человек способен на многое. Но, к сожалению, не каждый знает, на что он способен.
issues.translation_quote: but I'm overpowered by fear!
issues.justification: Semyon's line 'Боюсь, смогу ли я' is turned into an odd, inflated phrase ('overpowered by fear') that departs from the plain original and from his character voice.

issues.source_quote: Это Вам! Сувенир... Кнопочку нажмите.
issues.translation_quote: Oh, you shouldn't have...
issues.justification: Part of the flow is fine, but the earlier 'Вы говорите, Семён Семёнович' exchange is acceptable; main concern is the missing 'Дзинь' gag context (toy), minor.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: May you live... on nothing but... your salary!
issues.justification: Ellipses break the rhythm of the curse; the comic punch of the escalating Odessan-style curse is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Идиот! Дитям - мороженое!
issues.translation_quote: Ice cream for the young'uns, flowers for his broad.
issues.justification: 'Young'uns' and 'broad' impose an American gangster register that doesn't match the Soviet criminal's jargon ('дитям', 'баба'); inconsistent voice.

issues.source_quote: Строго на север, порядка... 50-ти метров, расположен туалэт, типа сортир, обозначенный на схеме буквами «Мэ» и «Жо».
issues.translation_quote: marked on the diagram with the letters "M" and "W"
issues.justification: The Russian М/Ж (men/women) markings are rendered with 'W', which loses the joke (Жо alludes to a vulgar word); the cultural humor is lost.

issues.source_quote: Кому из вас, когда найдёте клад
issues.translation_quote: I'm convinced that every one of you, upon finding a treasure, will do exactly as I did!
issues.justification: The reference to the well-known Gaidai film line (Kidnapping/Diamond Arm film-within-film bit about the treasure and the bonus) is rendered flatly without the bureaucratic-propaganda tone.

issues.source_quote: Шампанское по утрам пьют или аристократы, или дегенераты!
issues.translation_quote: In the morning, champagne is drunk only by aristocrats and degenerates.
issues.justification: Flat passive rendering loses the punchy, quoted-aphorism feel of the line.

issues.source_quote: Я встретил Вас и всё былое В отжившем сердце ожило...
issues.translation_quote: Came alive in my worn-out heart...
issues.justification: Romance lyrics are rendered literally without poetic register.

issues.source_quote: Куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.translation_quote: strike while the iron's hot, without leaving the till!
issues.justification: The joke is a deliberate mangling of two idioms; the translation keeps it but the first occurrence rendering as 'strike while the iron's hot' is fine; acceptable. Minor concern only.

issues.source_quote: Разрешите хотя бы… - Вот это попробуйте!
issues.translation_quote: - Now that, give it a try!
issues.justification: The colonel's dry joke (sending the eager subordinate off to try the offered cognac/tea) is unclear; the humorous point is lost.

issues.source_quote: Пароль старый - "Чёрт побери!"
issues.translation_quote: Dyamn it all!
issues.justification: Inconsistent spelling of the accented Russian-in-English ('Dyamn') renders the foreign-accent gag unevenly and 'Damn it all' differs from the established Russian catchphrase 'Чёрт побери'.

issues.source_quote: Что случилось, почему шеф здесь?
issues.translation_quote: Evrything as we agreed.
issues.justification: Typos used to mimic accent are inconsistent and look like errors ('Evrything', 'Allways', 'Thass').

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No! I ain't doing no such thing!
issues.justification: The deliberate rustic ungrammatical 'пойтить' is rendered with heavy American dialect that sounds off for a Soviet context.

issues.source_quote: Не взял попутных - это не таксист!
issues.translation_quote: Won't take passengers — he's no taxi driver!
issues.justification: Source means he didn't pick up other fares on the way; slight mistranslation.

issues.source_quote: Хороший мальчик...
issues.translation_quote: Good boy...
issues.justification: Acceptable, but 'Gyo-eh' and similar vocalizations are inconsistent.

issues.source_quote: Угу... С чьего трупа?
issues.translation_quote: Uh-huh... Whose corpse?
issues.justification: Fine, but earlier 'напоить, усыпить' list is rendered awkwardly as 'a person can be... gotten drunk'.
